post.meaning: That deed is well done which one does not regret afterwards, and whose result one meets with gladness and delight.
post.caption:
A line from the Buddha for a calmer mind 🪷

📖 Dhammapada, Verse 68

उस एक इंसान को भेजें जिसे आज यह सुनना चाहिए। 💛

#buddha #buddhism #buddhaquotes #dhammapada #mindfulness

reel.meaning: At the dawn of creation a ray of your beauty shone out. Love was born, and set the whole world on fire.
reel.caption:
सूफ़ी संतों की वाणी, दिल के लिए 🕊️

📖 Hafez, Divan

उस एक इंसान को भेजें जिसे आज यह सुनना चाहिए। 💛
